annotations.title: The entity file: everything we hold about one company

description: The entity file: ONE paid answer holding everything we hold about one company. Reach for it before you sign, onboard, pay or acquire a counterparty, and whenever you want the whole picture in ONE call rather than four separate facts stitched together. It holds identity and standing, the registered office, SIC activity and previous names, the filing position, a sanctions screen across our four lists, and the ownership chain to the ultimate parent — each cited to the register it came from with its retrieval time — plus ONE coverage block naming every register consulted and every one NOT consulted. Returns found, ambiguous, not_found or unknown for the company itself; a register that was not read is named as not read, never guessed. 33p UK-facing, settled in USDC at the dated rate. Not advice, not a credit check. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.
